Matt Jackson

  • USATF Level 2 Coach
  • 5+ years coaching state champions, D1 athletes & trail winners
  • NCAA DII XC & Indoor/Outdoor Track athlete
  • 13 years competitive running — 800m to 50 miles

Running has been transformative—for me and my athletes. My goal: help you find your best effort and learn to be proud of it. Whether you're chasing your first 5K or an ultra podium, let's build something together.

"Training is a conversation, not a monologue."

Every runner is unique. I focus on individualized, injury-prevention-first coaching that respects your life and accelerates your potential.

What They Say

"Matt meets you where you're at, fostering empowerment and collaboration. I've seen tremendous improvement in my race performances."

"I started working with Matt just about a year ago. At the time, I had been looking for a more structured approach to my training. I quickly realized Matt showed the same level of investment and enthusiasm into helping others achieve their goals, as I did to working toward my own. Matt takes a proactive approach to his coaching, through a deep understanding of evidence based practices and continuous pursuit to learn more. He meets you where you're at as an individual and what's going on in your life, which fosters a relationship of empowerment and collaboration between athlete + coach. Personally, I've seen a tremendous improvement in my race performances (trail + road) as result. But beyond that, I've noticed an immense amount of growth in myself since working with Matt."

— Caroline Alcorta

"Matt's approach is data-driven and deeply personal. I finally feel like I know what I'm doing as an athlete."

"Working with Coach Matt has been incredibly eye-opening. After five years of trail running, I came to Matt with a goal: train smarter, avoid another femoral stress fracture, and get faster for the Seattle Marathon. He delivered on all fronts. Matt's approach is both data-driven and deeply personal—he took the time to understand me as an athlete and made it clear this was a two-way street. His programming is creative, individualized, and always backed by a strong 'why' behind each workout. I finally feel like I know what I'm doing as an athlete and how to keep doing it without getting hurt."

— Joel Gartenberg

"Through Matt's strength programs, my injuries retreated and my running found a whole new type of power."

"I hired Matt after just one conversation about training. The depth of his knowledge of running and his passion for the work of coaching were immediately apparent. Throughout the following months, I became a totally different athlete. Matt works especially well with persistent injuries. Through the strength programs that I received, I found my injuries retreating and my running imbued with a whole new type of strength. He is also a very holistic coach who will try to understand your life, how your running fits into it, and what motivates you to run. Matt bears the mark of a truly great coach: he deftly passes on not only the routine motions of training but his deep knowledge of its methods."
